why: A side mirror reverses the order of letters and flips each letter. The backwards Z on the left becomes a normal Z on the right, and the T moves to the left: "T Z", which is option 1. Option 2 turns the letters upside down (a water image), and option 4 is the figure turned around.
trick: For letters in a mirror: reverse the order AND flip each letter left-right.
